age.evidence: All experiments were conducted with 6- to 8-week-old age-matched male and female wild-type C57BL/6J mice

sex.evidence: 6- to 8-week-old age-matched male and female wild-type C57BL/6J mice (Jackson Laboratory)

dosing.doses_raw: psilocin (0.1, 0.3, 1.0 mg/kg) in CPP; psilocin (0.3 mg/kg) in EPM
dosing.evidence: three doses of each treatment compound were assessed: psilocin (0.1, 0.3, 1.0 mg/kg)... On the day of testing (⩽1 hour prior to use), compounds were diluted in saline to the appropriate dose

dosing.doses_raw: 4-HO-MiPT (0.2, 0.5, 2.0 mg/kg) in CPP; 4-HO-MiPT (2.0 mg/kg) in EPM
dosing.evidence: animals were i.p. injected with either saline or a pre-assigned dose of 4-HO-MiPT (0.2, 0.5, 2.0 mg/kg)

dosing.doses_raw: 4-MeO-MiPT (0.03, 0.3, 3.0 mg/kg) in CPP; 4-MeO-MiPT (0.3 mg/kg) in EPM
dosing.evidence: On Test Day 2, animals were injected with a pre-assigned treatment and dose condition: psilocin (0.1, 0.3, or 1.0 mg/kg) or 4-MeO-MiPT (0.03, 0.3, or 3.0 mg/kg)
paroxetine (10 mg/kg), a serotonin transporter inhibitor with anxiolytic effects, served as a positive control

Each animal was i.p. injected with either saline (0.2 mg/kg) or fentanyl (0.1 mg/kg)... This procedure was replicated over 8 days, with animals receiving four alternating injections of saline and fentanyl.

handling.evidence: Three days prior to experimentation, animals underwent habituation to handling and sham intraperitoneal (i.p.) injections of saline (CPP); Four days prior to testing, mice underwent daily habituation to handling and sham i.p. injections (EPM)

group_housing.evidence: CPP: 'Animals were individually housed, and food was restricted to one three-gram food pellet per day'; EPM cohorts were instead 'group-housed by sex with ad libitum feeding'

day_night_flipped.evidence: EPM: 'Animals were housed on a 12-hour reverse light cycle with all experiments conducted during the dark cycle'; CPP: 'Animals were housed on a 12-hour light-dark cycle, and CPP experiments were conducted during the light cycle'

assays.assay_description: Three-room CPP chambers (Med Associates) with black, white, and grey compartments in sound-attenuating boxes. Preconditioning (Day 0): 30 min free access to all rooms for baseline preference. Conditioning (Days 1-8): alternating i.p. saline or fentanyl (0.1 mg/kg) confined to the paired room for 15 min with locomotion recorded. Test Day 1 (Day 9) and Test Day 2 (Day 12): 30 min free access 30 min after i.p. saline or psychedelic (psilocin, 4-MeO-MiPT within-subject; 4-HO-MiPT between-subject). Measures: CPP score, % time in fentanyl-paired room, total locomotor activity (beam breaks).

application_type.evidence: animals were i.p. injected with either saline or a pre-assigned dose of 4-HO-MiPT (0.2, 0.5, 2.0 mg/kg)

setup_habituation.evidence: Only handling/sham-injection habituation is described ('Three days prior to experimentation, animals underwent habituation to handling and sham intraperitoneal (i.p.) injections of saline'); no pre-test apparatus exposure is reported.

setup_restrain.evidence: Animals were then introduced to the neutral grey room with unrestricted access to the entire chamber for 30 minutes

food_restriction.evidence: Animals were individually housed, and food was restricted to one three-gram food pellet per day to maintain weight at or above 80% of the starting weight

water_restriction.evidence: No water source described in the CPP chamber; only food restriction is mentioned.

time_to_assay.evidence: Following treatment, mice were returned to their home cages for 30 minutes before testing to allow peak hallucinogenic effects to dissipate

sample_size.evidence: Psilocin group sizes (within-subject)-males: n = 10, 9, 10; females: n = 12, 9, 10. 4-HO-MiPT (between-subject)-males: n = 6-8 per dosing group; females: 10-13. 4-MeO-MiPT (within-subject)-males: n = 8, 10, 5; females: n = 10, 8, 8.

outcomes.summary: All groups acquired fentanyl CPP. Psilocin produced an overall reduction in fentanyl CPP score in females only (no effect in males); 4-MeO-MiPT reduced fentanyl CPP in both sexes; 4-HO-MiPT had no effect in either sex. Locomotor activity during testing was decreased by psilocin at 1.0 mg/kg in both sexes and by 4-MeO-MiPT in males.
outcomes.statistics: Psilocin CPP: males p = 0.9559; females p = 0.0062. Psilocin locomotion: males treatment × dose p = 0.0400; females p = 0.0055. 4-HO-MiPT CPP: males p = 0.6718; females p = 0.2249; locomotion males p = 0.6213, females p = 0.8774. 4-MeO-MiPT CPP: males p = 0.0007; females p = 0.0015; locomotion males p = 0.0005, females p = 0.2672.
outcomes.evidence: Psilocin reduced fentanyl CPP exclusively in females, 4-MeO-MiPT in both sexes, and 4-HO-MiPT had no effect.

B1_num_measures.evidence: A CPP score was calculated...; Fentanyl room preference (% time in fentanyl-paired room) was calculated...; Total locomotor activity (beam breaks) in males during testing.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Only total session values (time in room over the 30-min test, total locomotor activity) were analysed; no within-session binning reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: Measures were zone time (fentanyl-paired room) and locomotor beam breaks — spatial/locomotor, not ethological behaviours.

B5_social.evidence: CPP is a drug-context conditioning paradigm; no social stimulus or social construct is measured.

B6_cognitive.evidence: animals are conditioned to pair specific environmental contexts with drug exposure. The development of a preference for a drug-paired context... serves as a measure of the drug's rewarding properties

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Animal position and locomotion in the chambers were tracked via infrared photobeam detectors and recorded using Med-PC software

B8_multivariate.evidence: Analyses were two-way ANOVAs, t-tests and one-sample t-tests; no dimensionality reduction or multivariate behavioural analysis.

E1_environment_type.evidence: All experiments were conducted in three-room CPP chambers (Med Associates Inc.) housed in sound-attenuating boxes.

E2_shelter.evidence: No shelter or refuge described; the chamber consists of black, white and grey rooms with free access.

E3_bedding.evidence: No bedding or substrate described in the CPP chambers.

E4_nesting.evidence: No nesting material described in the testing apparatus.

E5_enrichment.evidence: No enrichment objects described in the CPP chamber.

E6_spatial.evidence: Animals were placed in the neutral room (grey) of the CPP apparatus with open access to all three rooms (black, white, and grey)

E7_social_context.evidence: Each animal was tested individually in the CPP chamber during test sessions.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water available in the CPP chamber; animals were food restricted in the home cage.

D1_continuity.evidence: CPP preconditioning (Day 0)... CPP conditioning (Days 1-8)... Test Day 1 on CPP Day 9 and Test Day 2 on CPP Day 12

D2_session_duration.evidence: Animals were then introduced to the neutral grey room with unrestricted access to the entire chamber for 30 minutes, during which locomotor activity was recorded.

D3_recording_days.evidence: Preconditioning (Day 0), conditioning Days 1-8 ('placed in the paired room... for 15 minutes, during which locomotor activity was recorded'; conditioning locomotion reported in Figures S3-S5), Test Day 9 and Test Day 12 — 11 recording days.

D4_baseline.evidence: CPP preconditioning (Day 0). Animals were placed in the neutral room... for 30 minutes. A baseline room preference was determined... and preconditioning time is subtracted in the CPP score.

D5_followup.evidence: Psychedelic treatment was given 30 min before each test; no behavioural recording ≥24 h after the psychedelic dose.

assays.assay_description: Four-arm EPM (Noldus) with two closed arms, two open arms, a central zone and evenly distributed overhead lights. Single 5-min between-subjects test 30 min after i.p. saline, paroxetine (10 mg/kg), psilocin (0.3 mg/kg), 4-MeO-MiPT (0.3 mg/kg) or 4-HO-MiPT (2.0 mg/kg). Live tracking with Basler camera and EthoVision XT; measures: % time in open arms, % time in closed arms, distance travelled.

application_type.evidence: Before testing, animals were i.p. injected with either saline, paroxetine (10 mg/kg), psilocin (0.3 mg/kg), 4-MeO-MiPT (0.3 mg/kg), or 4-HO-MiPT (2.0 mg/kg)

setup_habituation.evidence: Only handling/sham-injection habituation described: 'Four days prior to testing, mice underwent daily habituation to handling and sham i.p. injections.' No apparatus habituation reported.

setup_restrain.evidence: Animals were then placed in the center of the maze, facing the open arm, and the time spent... was live-tracked

food_restriction.evidence: mice were group-housed by sex with ad libitum feeding; no food is present in the elevated plus maze during the 5-min test.

water_restriction.evidence: No water source in the elevated plus maze during the 5-min test.

time_to_assay.evidence: animals were i.p. injected with either saline, paroxetine..., then returned to the home cage for 30 minutes. Animals were then placed in the center of the maze

sample_size.evidence: Group sizes (between-subject)-males: n = 10 (Saline), n = 7 (Paroxetine), n = 10 (Psilocin), n = 8 (4-HO-MiPT), n = 8 (4-MeO-MiPT); females: n = 11 (Saline), n = 8 (Paroxetine), n = 10 (Psilocin), n = 8 (4-HO-MiPT), n = 11 (4-MeO-MiPT)

outcomes.summary: Psilocin (0.3 mg/kg), 4-MeO-MiPT (0.3 mg/kg) and 4-HO-MiPT (2.0 mg/kg) did not significantly alter open-arm or closed-arm preference or distance travelled in either sex relative to saline. The positive control paroxetine reduced closed-arm preference in both sexes and increased open-arm preference in females.
outcomes.statistics: One-way ANOVA with Tukey-corrected post hoc comparisons; no significant differences between psychedelic-treated groups and saline in open arm %, closed arm % or distance travelled; paroxetine vs saline significant for closed arm preference (males and females) and open arm preference (females). *p < 0.05, **p < 0.01.
outcomes.evidence: None of the compounds significantly altered anxiety-like behaviors in EPM.

B1_num_measures.evidence: Anxiolytic-like behavior was measured as the percentage of time in the open arms, while anxiogenic-like behavior was measured as the percentage of time in the closed arms. Locomotor activity during testing was measured as total distance traveled in the maze (cm).

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Percentages were computed over the whole 5-min session; no within-session time-course analysis reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: Only zone time (open/closed/centre) and distance travelled were measured; no ethological acts such as grooming or rearing were scored.

B5_social.evidence: EPM assesses innate anxiety-like behaviour; no social stimulus or construct.

B6_cognitive.evidence: based on the innate murine preference for enclosed spaces when anxious and open spaces when exhibiting relaxed, exploratory behavior

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Live tracking data were recorded using a Basler Gen I Camera with EthoVision XT software (position tracking only).

B8_multivariate.evidence: One-way ANOVA was conducted to compare arm preference and locomotor data across control and treatment conditions.

E1_environment_type.evidence: Experiments were conducted in a four-arm EPM (Noldus, Leesburg, VA, USA) equipped with two closed arms, two open arms, a central zone

E2_shelter.evidence: EPM closed arms are part of the apparatus design, not an enclosed refuge (per rubric).

E3_bedding.evidence: Definitionally absent — no bedding in an elevated plus maze.

E4_nesting.evidence: Definitionally absent — no nesting material in the EPM.

E5_enrichment.evidence: No enrichment objects described in the maze.

E6_spatial.evidence: EPM arms are open-ended extensions of a central platform; per rubric EPM is not scored as multiple compartments.

E7_social_context.evidence: A between-subjects experimental design was used, with each animal being tested only once (individually in the maze).

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water in the EPM during the 5-min test.

D1_continuity.evidence: A between-subjects experimental design was used, with each animal being tested only once.

D2_session_duration.evidence: the time spent (in seconds) in the closed arms, open arms, and the center zone was live-tracked... for 5 minutes

D3_recording_days.evidence: ...randomly assigned to a treatment condition (psilocin, 4-MeO-MiPT, or 4-HO-MiPT) on a single test day

D4_baseline.evidence: No pre-drug EPM recording; between-subjects single test.

D5_followup.evidence: Testing occurred 30 min after injection; no recording ≥24 h post-dose.

judge_notes: Two behavioural paradigms identified: fentanyl CPP (preconditioning + conditioning + two test days, all doses/compounds/designs collapsed per rubric) and EPM. All candidates agreed on this structure.

Collapsed psilocin, 4-HO-MiPT and 4-MeO-MiPT arms (and within- vs between-subject designs) into a single CPP assay entry, per the rubric that different drugs/doses/designs in the same paradigm = 1 assay.

B1 for CPP set to 1 (2-3 measures: CPP score, % time in fentanyl-paired room, locomotor activity); gemma assigned score=2 while labelling the category '2-3' — internally inconsistent, corrected to the rubric point value.
B1 for EPM set to 1 (open arm %, closed arm %, distance travelled = 3 measures); gemma's score=2 with category '2-3' corrected.

D3 for CPP scored 2 (8-14 days): recording days = preconditioning Day 0, conditioning Days 1-8 (locomotion recorded and reported in Figures S3-S5 panels A/E), Test Day 9 and Test Day 12 = 11 days. All candidates scored 1 (2-7) by ignoring the conditioning-day locomotor data, which is explicitly reported.

housing_conditions.day_night_flipped set to 'yes' because the paper explicitly describes a 12-h reverse light cycle with dark-phase testing for EPM; the CPP cohort used a standard cycle with light-phase testing — both are noted in evidence (candidates split yes/no/not_reported).

CPP food_restriction = 'before' (chronic 3 g/day restriction to ≥80% body weight) per rubric preference when both 'before' and 'during' apply; EPM food_restriction = 'during' (ad libitum housing but no food in the maze), overriding gemma's 'no'.
setup_habituation = 'not_reported' for both assays: only handling/sham-injection habituation is described, not apparatus exposure.
Paroxetine and fentanyl included as dosing entries since they were administered to the animals, but they are not psychedelics; the psychedelic compounds are psilocin, 4-HO-MiPT and 4-MeO-MiPT.
